text:
rafi: Heads-up: we're doing a staggered cascade launch for next Thurs 11am PT. Need X + LinkedIn + partner seeding plan. Who owns cadence, A/B captions, and 48h engagement routing? cc @zoe @emma

zoe: I can own cadence + scheduling for X. Recommend staggered posts: 11:00am PT (announce), 2:00pm PT (stat + clip), 6:00pm PT (partner reposts), next day 9:00am PT (reminder).

emma: I'll own LinkedIn thread + A/B caption test (long vs short). Need partner-friendly copy (no links) and a plain-text version for reshares. Also need hero 1200x675 and 1:1 clip.

arjun: I'll build the partner kit and seed list: 8 partners + 5 micro-influencers. Will prep short blurbs they can repost. Also will set up tracking spreadsheet for leads.

rafi: Benchmark narrative should be 2 lines: latency SLO + cost delta. Keep customer quote short. Place quote in primary LI variant.

zoe: For X thread, plan 3 tweets: hook, stat/clip, CTA. Test two CTAs: "Register" vs "Watch live" to see CTR difference. Need UTMs for both.

emma: A/B captions: A = 1-sentence tight hook + link, B = 2-sentence explanation + link + stat. We'll allocate 50/50 audience split via manual scheduling.

arjun: Partner kit will include: PNG hero (1200x675), 15s vertical clip, plain-text caption, partner handles, and a "+CTA" short link (utm_source=partner). I'll hand off to partners by Tue EOD.

social-bot: Registration link -> https://redwood.ai/events/cascade?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=cascade_launch

zoe: Owners for 48h engagement: X 0-24h = zoe, X 24-48h = community volunteers; LI 0-24h = emma, LI 24-48h = sales-squad. Route hot replies (>3 replies or contains "demo") to #ae-inbound.

emma: I'll pin an FAQ reply on X with timezone conversions and quick agenda. Also will add canned replies for top 8 FAQs in the doc.

rafi: Legal review? Any risky claims in the stat?

arjun: Legal signoff pending but we have backup caption without the stat. Will update kit accordingly.

zoe: Final asset checklist to upload to #marketing-assets by Wed 18:00 PT: hero JPG, square PNG, 30s mp4, 15s vertical, alt text, captions (A/B), partner kit.

emma: I'll schedule LI thread and drop both caption variants in the doc for quick signoff.

rafi: Great. After launch we'll collect top 20 replies and surface likely demo leads. Measure CTR, signups, and partner reshares in first 48h. Thanks team :rocket:
